context: Lemma 7 Let (fn )n≥1 be a sequence of geodesically convex functions on M . Assume that fn (x) −−−→ n→∞ f (x), for all x in a dense subset M0 of M , where f : M → R is some given geodesically convex function. Then, fn is equi-Lipschitz and converges to f uniformly on any compact subset of M .
